title: Requirements Matrix (v1.2)
description: Clause-by-clause extraction of tender requirements with source attribution, supersession relations, and version binding via manifest_id.

matrix_id.description: Stable identifier for this requirements matrix instance.

manifest_id.description: Must match the manifest_id from file-manifest.json for this review cycle.

supersede_relations.description: Explicit supersession relations between requirements. Must be consistent with each requirement's superseded_by field, acyclic, and have valid endpoints.

requirement_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this requirement clause.

source_file_id.description: file_id from file-manifest referencing the tender-side source document.

location.description: Precise location in the source document (e.g. '第5页', 'body:3.2.1', 'page 1').

source_quote.description: Exact verbatim text copied from the source document. Must be the original wording, not a paraphrase or summary. May contain leading, trailing, or internal line breaks; must contain at least one non-whitespace character. Omission of source text must be represented as incomplete requirement, not a fabricated quote.

subject.description: Brief subject/topic of this requirement clause. Optional; useful for human navigation.

requirement_type.description: Classification of requirement type. qualification=资格要求; substantive_response=实质响应; scoring=评分项; submission=提交要求; compliance=合规要求; other=其他.

status.description: Current status of this requirement. active=有效; superseded=已被替代; withdrawn=已撤回; pending_review=待审核. Retained from v1.2 reviewed contracts.

condition.description: Conditional applicability (e.g. 'if bidding as consortium'). Omit for unconditional.

logic.description: Logic operator for compound sub-clauses: and=all required, or=any one sufficient, single=simple.

quantifier.description: Quantifier if applicable (e.g. 'at least 3', 'no fewer than'). Omit for non-quantified.

exception.description: Stated exceptions or exemptions. Omit if none.

proof_requirement.description: What evidence/proof is required to demonstrate compliance.

superseded_by.description: requirement_id of the clause that supersedes this one (if any). Must be consistent with supersede_relations.

is_mandatory.description: True if non-compliance results in rejection; false if scoring deduction.

notes.description: Additional notes or caveats about this requirement.

original_requirement_id.description: requirement_id of the original clause being superseded.

superseding_requirement_id.description: requirement_id of the clause that supersedes it.

relation_type.description: Nature of the supersession: replaces fully, modifies partially, or clarifies.
